integrity: The published matrix is independently checked for rank \(9\), self-orthogonality, and minimum distance \(16\). Every nonzero-dimensional subspace of \(\mathbb F_2^9\) is then enumerated exactly once, and all column triples are exhaustively tested.
scientific_limitations: The finding concerns the specific published \([43,9,16]_2\) generator. It does not classify all optimal self-orthogonal codes with these parameters, and it does not generalize the hierarchy to the other 65 optimal examples in the source.
title: Higher-support profile of the new \([43,9,16]_2\) self-orthogonal code
